prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Virtual Assistant for Cold Calling (B to B) in North America
We are seeking a talented and experienced Virtual Assistant to make cold calls on our behalf to potential clients in North America, with the aim of closing deals for our digitalization and Business Intelligence consultancy. Our company provides advice and support in digitalization on three levels: consulting in digitalization and Business Intelligence, realization of a business intelligence project to create dashboards facilitating decision-making and the organization of business data, and advice and implementation of an organizational solution, protection of intellectual property. As a Virtual Assistant, you will be representing our company and responsible for making cold calls to potential clients in North America, using persuasive language and strong communication skills to explain our services to potential clients and close deals for our digitalization and Business Intelligence consultancy. You will be documenting each call in an Open/Suite CRM system and ensuring confidentiality of all client information while maintaining professional communication at all times. This is a part-time position during a trial period, which will progress to full-time employment with the possibility to switch to full-time for excellent performers. You will be expected to achieve set targets of 3 to 5 qualified appointments per week for closing deals and contributing to the growth of the company. Great organization and attention to detail in maintaining records and following up on leads are key
</job>

text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan — a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’m reaching out because this role combines two things I value highly: clear communication and organized, reliable follow-through. I understand you’re looking for someone who can represent your company professionally, make persuasive cold calls, document each interaction carefully in CRM, and help drive qualified appointments. I’m comfortable working with structured processes, maintaining detailed records, and keeping client information confidential.

While my background is in data and dashboard work rather than phone sales, my experience has trained me to be methodical, detail-oriented, and focused on outcomes. In my work, I’ve regularly cleaned and organized messy information, built reporting systems, and turned raw data into clear action points for decision-making. That same discipline translates well to lead tracking, call documentation, follow-up management, and maintaining consistent pipeline hygiene.

One relevant project was **Support ticket analytics** for **Clipboardly**, a productivity software company. I built a **support dashboard with a cleaned-up tag taxonomy, response times, and backlog by product area** using **SQL, Power BI, and Zendesk**. One result was that **first response time went down 27% after staffing changes the dashboard suggested**. That project reflects the kind of structured thinking and operational attention I would bring to your outreach process.

If selected, I would focus on being organized, professional, and responsive, with a strong commitment to maintaining accurate call notes, following up reliably, and handling each prospect interaction with care. I understand the importance of building trust quickly, especially when speaking to businesses in North America about digitalization and Business Intelligence services.

I’d be glad to support your team during the trial period and contribute to your goals of securing qualified appointments. Thank you for your consideration, and I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can help.
